description:
Where a child sits on the growth charts, calculated exactly from the WHO LMS tables (Child Growth Standards 2006, Growth Reference 2007) and, for the United States and Australia after age 2, the CDC 2000 charts: weight, height, weight-for-height and BMI percentiles and z-scores, with the WHO cut-offs (wasting, stunting, overweight, thinness). Severe acute malnutrition is flagged as urgent. With a country, it says which chart that country's health record uses; 78 countries covered.

Use when you have a child's sex, age and weight or height and want the percentile. For malnutrition with an arm measurement, or general questions about growth, use paediatric_question_with_sources.

inputSchema.description: The child's sex, age and at least one measurement.

age_months.description: Age in months, 0 to 240. The WHO charts go to 228 months (19 years); 229 to 240 need country US, whose CDC charts reach 20 years.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2: picks the chart the country uses when PediBot has it, and reports which one it uses

height_cm.description: Length (under 2, lying down) or height in centimetres. Give weight_kg, height_cm or both.

sex.description: m for a boy, f for a girl

weight_kg.description: Weight in kilograms. Give weight_kg, height_cm or both: at least one is needed.

name: child_growth_percentile

outputSchema.description: Each indicator with its percentile, and the chart it came from.

country.description: The charts the country's health record uses, how well PediBot's calculation matches them, and the official source

indicators.description: name, label, value, z, percentile, flag and flag_label for each indicator

level.description: routine, or urgent for severe acute malnutrition

reference.description: who or cdc: the tables used

sources.description: The WHO or CDC reference used

warnings.description: What to do when the result is urgent

title: Child growth percentile
